Public domain (Unlicense) or MIT No Attribution, at the user's choice
(LICENSE.txt: neither asks for a notice in source or binary form).
dr_mp3 contains minimp3 (https://github.com/lieff/minimp3, CC0).

Vendored unmodified: dr_mp3.h, dr_flac.h, dr_wav.h, LICENSE.txt. Single-file
decoders, compiled into src/soundtrack/xst_decode.c (the user's music folder
as Xbox custom soundtracks). To update: copy the same files from the new
commit and change this file.
